第883章 丢不掉的玩具车（第1页）
老两口一听到他这样的发言，直接炸了。
难不成那鬼说它不是坏鬼，就真的不是坏鬼了？
要真是这样的话，这世界上也不会有那么多被骗，然后受伤的人出现了。
老两口只觉得孙子太天真了，谁说的话都相信。
更何况还有个词叫做“鬼话连篇”，说的就是鬼会哄骗人。
孙子因为年纪小，容易上当受骗，可汤奶奶和老伴儿可是活了几十年的老江湖了，怎么可能随意听信一个鬼的话。
所以不管孙子说什么，他们都铁了心要将这个玩具车给我丢掉。
至于孙子威胁他们要跟着玩具车一块走的行为，虽然刚刚听到的时候有些担心，但他们想了想，大不了这几天先盯着孙子，把他关在家里。
等过几天，孙子的情绪肯定就会慢慢平稳下来的，最终他只能接受现实，然后回归正常生活。
他们就还不信了，两个大人还看管不住一个小孩。
于是汤奶奶立马佯装屈服的样子，无奈的对孙子说。
“好好好，我们先不丢这个玩具车，时间还这么早，咱不吵吵闹闹的，免得影响到了其他的邻居，你先进来吧。”
汤奶奶的语气很温和，看上去真的像已经妥协了。
而陈万星到底年纪还小，根本分不清奶奶这是在套路他还是真心实意，所以他便老老实实的往回走。
结果刚进屋，就被汤奶奶一把抓住了胳膊，然后死死环抱住。
在禁锢住孙子行动的同时，汤奶奶又赶紧对一旁的老伴道。
陈爷爷立马回过神，拿出曾经参加短跑比赛的速度冲出了家门，一两秒就不见了身影。

而小小的陈万星见此情景，也终于反应过来了，他这是被爷爷奶奶联合起来欺骗了。
于是他嗷的一声又哭了出来，并且这次哭的还比刚刚更加伤心欲绝。
一口一个“我还是个孩子你们居然骗我”“再也不要相信你了”等等话。
汤奶奶见孙子哭的这么惨，却没有安慰他，而是一再强调，他们这样做都是为了他好。
不过汤奶奶也已经料到会是现在这样的情况，反正多等几天吧，小孩子的注意力转移得很快的，最多三五天，孙子陈万星肯定就不会再纠结玩具车的事情了。
她就这样一直强行将孙子留在家里，过了大概快一个小时，陈爷爷才从外面回来。
之所以出去那么久，是因为陈爷爷压根不敢将玩具车丢在小区楼下的垃圾桶里，甚至连小区附近的垃圾桶，他都不敢丢。
硬生生走到了一两公里外的地方，然后把这个玩具车丢进了垃圾桶。
这个垃圾桶距离家这么远，平时孙子玩是绝对不会跑到这么远的地方来，所以他才彻底放心，觉得这玩具车将永远不会出现在孙子眼前，更不会出现在他们家里。
汤奶奶得知这一点后，也跟着松了一口气。
接下来的这一整个白天，老两口都在想办法劝说孙子，然后转移他的注意力。
本以为按照这样的计划进行下去，孙子很快就能调理好心情的。
但是让他们没有想到的是，这边孙子的心情还没调理好，那个被他们视为“灾难”的玩具车，竟然又出现了。
这天晚上一家三口折腾到很晚才睡下，汤奶奶还生怕晚上孙子做出点什么事来，又去他房间挨着他睡觉了。
这一晚上其实是相安无事的，可是第二天一大早，汤奶奶就被眼前的一幕震惊得吓出了尖叫。
因为昨天被陈爷爷丢掉的玩具车，竟然再次出现在了孙子的书桌上。

Chapter 883 The Toy Car That Can’t Be Lost (Page 1)
When the old couple heard what he said, they immediately exploded.
Could it be that just because the ghost said it wasn't a bad ghost, it really wasn't a bad ghost?
If that were the case, there wouldn't be so many people in the world who were deceived and then injured.
The old couple just felt that their grandson was too naive and believed everything anyone said.
What's more, there is a word called "ghost talk", which means that ghosts can deceive people.
The grandson is easily deceived because of his young age, but Grandma Tang and his wife have been in the world for decades, so how could they just listen to a ghost?
So no matter what my grandson said, they were determined to throw this toy car away from me.
As for their grandson threatening them to follow the toy car, although they were a little worried when they first heard it, they thought about it and decided to keep an eye on their grandson and lock him at home for the next few days.
After a few days, the grandson's mood will surely calm down. In the end, he can only accept the reality and return to normal life.
They still didn't believe it. Two adults couldn't look after a child.
So Grandma Tang immediately pretended to surrender and said helplessly to her grandson.
"Okay, okay, let's not throw away this toy car first. It's still so early and we won't make any noise so as not to affect other neighbors. You can come in first."
Grandma Tang's tone was very gentle, and she really seemed to have compromised.
After all, Chen Wanxing was still young and couldn't tell whether grandma was tricking him or sincere, so he walked back honestly.
As soon as she entered the house, Grandma Tang grabbed her arm and hugged her tightly.
While restraining her grandson from moving, Grandma Tang hurriedly said to her wife beside her.
Grandpa Chen immediately came to his senses, rushed out of the house at the speed of a sprinter, and disappeared within a second or two.
When the little Chen Wanxing saw this scene, he finally realized that he had been deceived by his grandparents.
So he cried again, and this time he cried even more heartbroken than before.
He kept saying things like, "I'm still a child and you lied to me," "I'll never believe you again," and so on.
When Grandma Tang saw her grandson crying so miserably, she did not comfort him. Instead, she repeatedly emphasized that they were doing this for his own good.
However, Grandma Tang had also expected that the situation would be like this. Anyway, just wait a few more days. Children's attention shifts quickly. In three to five days at most, grandson Chen Wanxing will definitely no longer be obsessed with the toy car.
She kept forcing her grandson to stay at home. It was almost an hour before Grandpa Chen came back from outside.
The reason why he was out for so long was because Grandpa Chen didn't dare to throw the toy car in the trash can downstairs in the community. He didn't even dare to throw it away in the trash can near the community.
I walked a kilometer or two away and threw the toy car into the trash can.
This trash can was so far away from home, and his grandson would never come so far to play, so he was completely relieved, feeling that this toy car would never appear in front of his grandson, let alone in their home.
After Grandma Tang learned this, she also breathed a sigh of relief.
During the entire day that followed, the old couple was trying to think of ways to persuade their grandson and divert his attention.
I thought that by following this plan, my grandson would be able to adjust his mood soon.
But what they didn't expect was that their grandson's mood hadn't been adjusted yet, and the toy they regarded as a "disaster"The car actually appeared again.
That night, the family of three worked hard until very late before going to bed. Grandma Tang was still afraid that her grandson would do something that night, so she went to his room to sleep next to him.
The night was actually peaceful, but early the next morning, Grandma Tang was so shocked by the scene in front of her that she screamed.
Because the toy car thrown away by Grandpa Chen yesterday actually appeared on his grandson's desk again.
